attempts.failures: Four active-transfer cases did not trigger a download before timeout when only one byte of a 21-byte response had arrived. Unobserved waiter rejections also made the process fail. The report incorrectly used characterized status and error names overwrote case names; all original bytes are retained.

attempts.changes: Use21504 total bytes and4096 initial bytes to permit Chromium download detection; await click and event together; preserve case names independently of errors; reject incomplete characterization status.

limitations: No Flashwright implementation or parity claim.
Context-close cancellation error text may be schedule-dependent; retain typed closure and cancellation separately.
